literacyKits.intro: We create and hand-deliver free literacy kits to organizations serving young learners. Each kit is geared toward upper elementary students (3rd–5th grade), and we aim to serve immigrant and/or low-income students and organizations.

faq.question: Who are these programs for?
faq.answer: Anyone. Our programs are designed for schools, nonprofits, and any individuals or organizations serving students in grades K–8. They work for after-school programs and home learning, and everything we offer is provided at no cost.

faq.question: Why work with us?
faq.answer: We are youth-led and understand student needs. Our materials are fully developed by teens and focused for kids with fun, relatable content for their age. Everything we offer is completely free.

faq.question: What do you offer?
faq.answer: Hands-on workshops, free literacy kits for organizations, and community events. Reach out and we'll help you find the right fit for your group.

faq.question: How do organizations receive a literacy kit?
faq.answer: Visit our Literacy Kits page to see what's included and request a kit. Kits are geared toward 3rd–5th graders and we prioritize immigrant and/or low-income students and organizations.
